text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B repeatedly at a profit, but a gain relative to my cost basis is not by itself a reason to sell; I should consider its future prospects and portfolio role.","I bought more Stock C at higher prices after selling some earlier. I should base each buy on its current expected return and risk, not on past trades or a desire to make a position feel right.","Despite frequent account checks, I made no trades in several periods. I should keep avoiding action for its own sake and judge decisions by their effect on the whole portfolio."]}
